text.ja: 村上准教授がUNESCOで開催されたLT4Allにて、「Language Sphere: A Sociotechnical Approach to Bilingual Dictionary Creation for Indigenous Languages」の講演を行いました。
text.en: Prof. Murakami gave an invited talk titled "Language Sphere: A Sociotechnical Approach to Bilingual Dictionary Creation for Indigenous Languages" in LT4All held at UNESCO.

text.ja: 西村さんと佐藤さんが情報処理学会 第85回全国大会で研究発表を行いました.
text.en: Mr. Nishimura and Mr. Sato, gave a research presentation at The 85th National Convention of IPSJ.

text.ja: 大井さんが，サービスコンピューティング研究会で研究発表を行い，若手奨励賞を受賞しました．
text.en: Mr. Oi gave a research presentation at the Services Computing Workshop and received the Young Scientist Incentive Award.

text.ja: 元澤さんが，The 24th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education(AIED 2023)　のワークショップで研究発表を行いました.
text.en: Ms. Motozawa, gave a research presentation at the workshop ofthe 24th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education(AIED2023)

text.ja: 北川さんが，合同エージェントワークショップ＆シンポジウム2023で研究発表を行いました.
text.en: Mr. Kitagawa gave a research presentation at Joint Agent Workshop & Symposium 2023 in Japan.

text.ja: 北川さん，松本さん，森さん，山本さんが，電子情報通信学会 総合大会で研究発表を行いました.
text.en: Mr. Kitagwa, Mr. Matsumoto, Ms. Mori and Mr. Yamamoto gave a research presentation at The General Conference of The Institute of Electronics, Information and Communication Engineers.

text.ja: 村上教授らが編集した書籍「Human-Centered Services Computing for Smart Cities」がSpringerより出版されました.
text.en: Prof. Murakami’s edited book Human-Centered Services Computing for Smart Cities has been published by Springer .

presentations.image: HCSCSC/Human-Centered Services Computing for Smart Cities.png

text.ja: 村上教授のモノグラフ論文「Human–Machine Collaboration for a Multilingual Service Platform」がSpringerより出版されました.
text.en: Prof. Murakami’s monograph paper Human–Machine Collaboration for a Multilingual Service Platform has been published by Springer .

presentations.image: HCSCSC/Human-Centered Services Computing for Smart Cities.png

text.ja: 北川さんがThe 22nd International Conference on Practical applications of Agents and Multi-Agent Systems(PAAMS 2024)で研究発表を行いました.
text.en: Mr. Kitagawa from our lab gave a research presentation at the 22nd International Conference on Practical applications of Agents and Multi-Agent Systems (PAAMS 2024)

text.ja: 元澤さんがThe 30th International Conference on Collaboration Technologies and Social Computing(CollabTech 2024)で研究発表を行いました.
text.en: Ms. Motozawa from our lab gave a research presentation at The 30th International Conference on Collaboration Technologies and Social Computing(CollabTech 2024)

text.ja: 元澤さんがThe 8th International Conference on Information Technology(InCIT 2024)で研究発表を行いました.
text.en: Ms. Motozawa from our lab gave a research presentation at The 8th International Conference on Information Technology(InCIT 2024)

text.ja: 山本さんが、The 23rd IEEE/WIC International Conference on Web Intelligence and Intelligent Agent Technologyで研究発表を行いました.
text.en: Mr. Yamamoto from our lab gave a research presentation at The 23rd IEEE/WIC International Conference on Web Intelligence and Intelligent Agent Technology

text.ja: 砂田さんが、第64回人工知能学会 セマンティックウェブとオントロジー研究会で研究発表を行いました.
text.en: Mr. Sunada from our lab gave a research presentation at The Japanese Society for Artificial Intelligence Semantic Web and Ontology Study Group

text.ja: 西村さんが、The 13th International Global Wordnet Conference (GWC2025)で研究発表を行いました.
text.en: Mr. Nishimura from our lab gave a research presentation at The 13th International Global Wordnet Conference (GWC2025)

text.ja: 西村さん、元澤さん、森さんがHCS研究会にて研究発表を行いました.
text.en: Mr. Nishimura, Ms. Motozawa and Ms. Mori from our lab gave a research presentation at HCS Workshop.

text.ja: 西村さん，元澤さん，北川さん，山本さんの4名が2024年度情報理工学研究科の研究奨励賞を受賞されました！おめでとうございます!
text.en: Mr.Nishimura, Ms.Motozawa, Mr.Kitagawa, and Mr.Yamamoto have been awarded the Graduate School Research Encouragement Award in 2024! Congratulations!

text.ja: 元澤さんが2021年度情報理工学研究科の研究優秀賞を受賞されました！おめでとうございます!
text.en: Ms.Motozawa has been awarded the Graduate School Research Excellence Award in 2021! Congratulations!

text.ja: 松本さんと中川さんが，サービスコンピューティング研究会で研究発表を行い，松本さんが電子情報通信学会サービスコンピューティング研究専門委員会若手奨励賞を受賞しました！
text.en: Mr.Matsumoto and Mr.Nakagawa gave a research presentation at the Services Computing Workshop and Mr.Matsumoto received the Young Scientist Incentive Award.

text.ja: 砂田さん，北川さん，松本さん，森叶葉さん，山本さん，岩野さん，加奥さん，富田さん，中川さん，森由璃亜さんの計10名が，情報処理学会第87回全国大会で研究発表を行いました！
text.en: Mr.Sunada, Mr.Kitagawa, Mr.Matsumoto, Ms.Kanaha Mori, Mr.Yamamoto, Mr.Iwano, Ms.Kaoku, Mr.Tomita, Mr.Nakagawa, and Ms.Yuria Mori, presented their research at The 87th National Convention of the Information Processing Society of Japan.
